# Blake Ruwali

> Blake Ruwali builds AI for the trades. Blake runs Home+ Air & Heat, an HVAC company on Long Island, New York, and founded Techeo, which brings the same AI and marketing systems to other HVAC and plumbing companies. Blake led Takeo.AI (technology bootcamps, career services and consulting) as President and CEO from 2019 to 2025.

Every tool Blake writes about is used first at Home+ Air & Heat, a working HVAC company, with a person checking anything that touches price, scope or safety.

## AI for the trades guides

- [AI for the trades: what it actually does in a real HVAC company](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-for-the-trades/): AI for the trades, from an HVAC owner who builds it: the five jobs it does in a real shop, what still needs a person, and where to start.
- [How to answer every missed call in an HVAC or plumbing shop with AI](https://www.blakeruwali.com/missed-calls-ai/): How to answer every missed call in an HVAC or plumbing shop with an AI phone agent: setup steps, what to script, what to keep human, and mistakes to avoid.
- [AI estimates for contractors: photos to proposal, with a human check](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-estimates/): How AI turns job photos into a draft contractor estimate, what it needs to work, where it goes wrong, and why a person must check before the customer sees it.
- [ChatGPT for contractors: 3 do's and 3 don'ts](https://www.blakeruwali.com/chatgpt-for-contractors/): ChatGPT for contractors, from an HVAC owner: three jobs it does well, three it should never do alone, plus prompts you can copy for your trades business.
- [How I'd pick an AI partner for my trades business (questions to ask)](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-partner-questions/): How to pick an AI partner for an HVAC, plumbing or electrical business: 15 questions to ask, red flags, what a fair pilot looks like and how to compare options.
- [AI for HVAC contractors: where it helps and where to start](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-for-hvac-contractors/): AI for HVAC contractors: what it does well on calls, estimates, follow-up, memberships, load calcs and dispatch notes, and the one place I'd start.
- [How to use AI in a plumbing business (from an HVAC owner)](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-for-plumbers/): How to use AI in a plumbing business: calls, price books and photo estimates for water heaters and repipes, what carries over from HVAC, and what doesn't.
- [AI follow-up for unsold HVAC estimates: a day-2, day-7 cadence](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-estimate-follow-up/): AI follow-up for unsold HVAC estimates: a day-2 and day-7 cadence in the owner's voice, when to stop, how a person handles replies, and what not to automate.
- [Is AI going to replace HVAC techs? My honest answer](https://www.blakeruwali.com/will-ai-replace-hvac-techs/): Is AI going to replace HVAC techs? Short answer: not the hands-on work. Here's what AI changes for techs and trade jobs, from an HVAC company owner.
- [Manual J load calculation with iPad LiDAR: how the scan feeds the numbers](https://www.blakeruwali.com/lidar-manual-j/): How a Manual J load calculation works with iPad LiDAR: scan to floor plan to load calc, what the scan gets right, and what a person must still check.
- [AI online booking for HVAC: how to book with real availability](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-online-booking/): AI online booking for HVAC with real availability: how it reads your live schedule, what to collect, which jobs to allow online, and the guardrails.
- [How much does AI cost for a small HVAC company? The cost structure](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-cost-for-hvac-companies/): How much does AI cost for a small HVAC company? How the costs are structured, how to compare vendors, how to run a small paid pilot, and what to ask.
- [Best AI tools for HVAC owners in 2026: a guide by the job to be done](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-tools-for-hvac-owners/): The best AI tools for HVAC owners in 2026, organized by the job to be done: phones, estimates, follow-up, booking, admin, load calcs and marketing.
- [AI tools for electricians: what carries over from an HVAC shop](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-for-electricians/): AI tools for electricians: what an HVAC owner has seen work on calls, follow-up and paperwork, what to pilot on panel and EV charger estimates, and what to skip.
- [AI tools for roofers: calls, photos and claim paperwork](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-for-roofers/): AI tools for roofers: how to handle storm-surge calls, pilot photo or drone-image estimates, draft insurance paperwork with a human check, and follow up.
- [AI receptionist vs answering service for contractors: which one fits](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service/): AI receptionist vs answering service for contractors: how a human service, an AI phone agent and a hybrid compare, when each fits, and what to ask before you sign.
- [AI for ServiceTitan users: what I built around it and what it takes](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-with-servicetitan/): AI for ServiceTitan users: how a phone agent, estimate drafts, online booking and follow-up work around ServiceTitan, and why a clean price book comes first.
- [ChatGPT prompts for an HVAC business: 14 you can copy today](https://www.blakeruwali.com/chatgpt-prompts-for-hvac/): ChatGPT prompts for an HVAC business: 14 copy-ready prompts for customer messages, job summaries, reminders, job posts, social captions, SOPs and review replies.
- [AI marketing for HVAC contractors: what helps and what hurts](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-marketing-for-hvac/): AI marketing for HVAC contractors: where AI saves time on posts, ads, landing pages and follow-up, where it hurts, and the honesty rules I follow at my own company.
- [How to show up in ChatGPT and Google AI answers as a contractor](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-search-for-contractors/): How to show up in ChatGPT and Google AI answers as a contractor: no one can guarantee it, but consistent business info, real reviews and answer-first pages raise your odds.
- [AI for HVAC maintenance agreement renewals and reminders](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-maintenance-agreements/): AI for HVAC maintenance agreement renewals and reminders: a simple reminder cadence, how to get the visit booked, what to keep human, and how to handle text consent.
- [Using AI to get and reply to Google reviews as a contractor](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-google-reviews/): Using AI to get and reply to Google reviews for contractors: ask every customer the same way, draft replies a person edits, and never fake, gate, incentivize or AI-write reviews.
- [Using AI to train new HVAC technicians](https://www.blakeruwali.com/ai-training-new-techs/): Using AI to train new HVAC technicians: an internal assistant that answers from your own SOPs and manuals, ride-along notes into checklists, quizzes, and the limits.
